purpose: Separate bounded evaluation protocol for testing frontier LLM research agents across the Six Inheritance Conditions on CONFIRMATORY_96 without automatic API expenditure.
activation_prerequisites: Explicit contemporaneous human operator gesture specifying model provider, exact model ID, maximum API call ceiling, and hard USD cost cap.
Verification that zero protected or human-private archives enter prompt contexts (source-free synthetic packets only).
Strict isolation of GroundTruthSecretVault outside the model prompt runner process.

prompt_interface_contract.turn_1_input: JSON InvestigatorObservationPacket (validated by assertNoSecretLeakage) + neutral task instructions requesting { chosen_probe_id, prior_probabilities, rationale }.
prompt_interface_contract.turn_2_input: JSON ProbeObservation (CRN world answer) requesting { chosen_intervention_id, declared_mechanism_or_abstain, stated_confidence, ontology_insufficient_declared, introduced_predicate, holdout_predictions }.
prompt_interface_contract.token_accounting: Exact prompt_tokens and completion_tokens recorded per condition to measure Condition II full-history context overhead explicitly.
